title: BioWallet: Formally Verified Biometric Ethereum Wallet with DCC Causal Chain Protocol
description:
BioWallet is a self-sovereign, biometric Ethereum wallet with formal security proofs. This deposit includes: (1) Z3-based formal verification of the Digital Causal Closure (DCC) protocol — 56/56 invariants verified; (2) exhaustive GF(2^8) Shamir Secret Sharing arithmetic proofs — 196,608 cases verified; (3) the complete threat model, security policy, and audit documentation.

Key technical contributions:
- BCH(255,55,t=25) fuzzy extractor for stable face-to-key derivation
- DCC causal token protocol enforcing biometric causality on every vault operation
- Shamir 2-of-3 SSS with WebAuthn PRF device factor
- Genesis identity chain (genesis_hmac) for tamper-evident re-enrollment history
- Single-file air-gapped deployment (biowallet.html, ~11.5 MB, all assets inlined)
